HAND-AUTHORED contract fixtures for the Instagram connector. They are NOT recordings from the live Graph API.
They follow the shapes in Meta's documentation for the Instagram API with Facebook Login (see the top of docs/SOCIAL_INSTAGRAM.md for the URLs
and the list of details still unverified). After the live test in Development mode, replace them with recorded payloads and re-run
`tests/unit/instagramConnector.test.ts` to see exactly where reality differs.
